captions.detailed: A retro-style countertop air fryer with a stainless-steel/grey rounded main body. The front face features a black control panel containing two rotatable dials (for time and temperature) and a small power switch. Below this is a sliding basket drawer with a grey handle that includes a bright red release latch.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a retro stainless air fryer. It should have a curved main housing, a dark front control panel with rotatable timer and temperature dials, a small pivoting power switch, and a sliding drawer basket with a handle and a red release latch.
captions.factory: Construct the main body shell using a chamfered and hollowed Box. Create the front control panel as a thin box on the front face. Model the dials using Cylinders and the power switch as a small Box with a revolute joint. Build the drawer using a hollowed Box, adding a handle with a red latch prismatically jointed to slide on top of the handle structure.
